field_records.note: getter loads the member object from [outer + 0x788] before calling the stub

aggregate reads the signed 32-bit group count from [obj + 0x50]; count <= 0 returns 0 at once
aggregate reads the group array base from [obj + 0xad8]; groups are 24-byte entries, each with a begin pointer at +0 and an end pointer at +8

non_claims: Object contents beyond outer + 0x788, member + 0x30, aggregate + 0x50/+ 0xad8, and group-element + 0x10 are not modelled
The third qword of each 24-byte group entry is never read and is not modelled
The stub's second caller, site 0x5e69df3 in 0x5e68fd0..0x5e6b82a, is recorded by site only; that function's internals were not read and its argument setup is not claimed
Neighbouring getter 0x5eeb630 and its target 0x5f91010 are not covered; they need their own scope check
The SIMD pairing in the aggregate is an implementation detail: the observable sum is the plain sum of the + 0x10 fields, which the model implements directly

semantics.aggregate_sum: count = signed32([obj + 0x50]); if count <= 0 return 0; total = 0; for each of the first count 24-byte groups at [obj + 0xad8]: for each pointer p in [group.begin, group.end): total += [p + 0x10] (64-bit wrapping); return total

semantics.getter: *out = aggregate_sum([[outer + 0x788] + 0x30]); return 1 unconditionally; no null check
